src: Pictures can help expand our knowledge of the outer Solar System, but scientific instruments and dwell times much longer than a hasty flyby are necessary to increase our understanding of these distant neighbors. Send orbiters to the two furthest gas giants and probe their atmospheres. While in the furthest reaches of our system, explore the moons of these giants as well. An upgraded Tracking Station and higher level comm tech will be necessary in order to receive scientific data over such great distances.
zh: 照片有助于拓展我们对太阳系外侧的认知，但要加深对这些遥远邻居的了解，必须借助科学仪器，并具备远长于匆匆飞掠的驻留时间。向两颗最遥远的气态巨行星发射轨道器，并探测它们的大气层。在抵达太阳系最深处的同时，也探索这些巨行星的卫星。为了在如此遥远的距离接收科学数据，需要升级追踪站并掌握更高级别的通信技术。

drift.src: Pictures can help expand our knowledge of the outer Solar System, but scientific instruments and dwell times much longer

src: Improved, lunar rated heatshield for the Gemini Capsule. Can be switched to the Gemini B configuration with a hatch. Gemini lacks the radiative heat protection of more advanced capsules. Extremely gentle Lunar reentries only.
zh: 改进型双子座乘员舱防热盾，具备月球再入能力。可切换为带舱门的双子座 B构型。双子座缺乏更先进乘员舱的辐射防热能力。仅支持极其平缓的月球再入。

src:
Program: Early Satellites (Heavy)
Type: Required

A polar orbit is one in which a satellite passes above or nearly above both poles of the body being orbited on each revolution. It therefore has an inclination of (or very close to) 90 degrees to the equator. A satellite in a polar orbit will pass over the equator at a different longitude on each of its orbits. Place a satellite weighing at least 400 kg into a polar orbit so we can study the advantages in greater detail.
zh:
项目：早期卫星（重型）
类型：必要

极地轨道是指卫星在每次公转中都会经过或接近天体两极上空的轨道。因此其对赤道的轨道倾角为（或非常接近）90度。极轨卫星每次绕行都会在不同的经度穿过赤道。将一颗质量至少为 400 kg 的卫星送入极地轨道，以便我们更详细地研究其优势。

src:
Program: Jupiter Observation
Type: Required

Create a probe and send it to flyby Io within 7800 km. Make sure to transmit science from the flyby.
zh:
项目：木星观测
类型：必要

建造一颗探测器，并将其送至飞掠木卫一 7800 km 以内。务必在飞掠期间传回科学数据。

src:
Program: Uncrewed Lunar Surface Exploration
Type: Optional

Design and successfully launch a craft that can achieve a soft landing on the Moon and return science data back to Earth.

This is a series of @maxCompletions contracts, of which @index have been completed.
zh:
项目：无人月球表面探测
类型：可选

设计并成功发射一艘能够在月球软着陆并将科学数据传回地球的航天器。

这是一个包含 @maxCompletions 个合同的系列，已完成 @index 个。

src:
Program: Crewed Mars Exploration
Type: Optional

Design and successfully launch an uncrewed probe to land on Mars, gather surface samples, and return to Earth.
zh:
项目：载人火星探测
类型：可选

设计并成功发射一艘无人探测器，使其在火星着陆，采集地表样本并返回地球。

src:
Program: Second Generation Commercial Applications
Type: Required

Satellites have proven to be a reliable way to communicate with our comrades in the Western Hemisphere. We would like to increase the capacity of the link between Moscow and Cuba.

Historical example: Molniya 2 series satellites (1,700kg, Molniya-M).
zh:
项目：第二代专注效益应用
类型：必要

卫星已被证明是与西半球同志进行通信的可靠途径。我们希望提高莫斯科与古巴之间链路的容量。

历史参考：闪电2系列卫星（1,700kg，闪电-M）。

src:
Program: Early Inner Planet Probes
Type: Required

Design and successfully launch an uncrewed probe that will enter into an orbit of Venus.
zh:
项目：早期内行星探测器
类型：必要

设计并成功发射一艘无人探测器，使其进入金星轨道。

src: Very little is known about how liquids behave in a microgravity environment. Various tests are needed to analyze the liquids to properly design fluid storage tanks in the future.This experiment can be completed once. NOTE: This experiment takes 2 hours.
zh: 人们对液体在微重力环境下的行为知之甚少。需要进行各种测试来分析液体，以便将来合理设计储液罐。该实验仅可完成一次。注意：该实验耗时 2 小时。
注意：该实验耗时 90 天。

drift.zh: 科学核心 TL3 - 质量：-76% 成本：+25% 功率：-99.4%

src: A basic pressure-fed booster engine developed by General Electric to power American-built Wasserfall missiles for the Hermes program (CTV-G-5). Although the design was deemed unsuitable for military use, several Hermes A-1 missiles were still flown to gain experience in the construction and operation of large rockets.
zh: 通用电气开发的一种基础挤压循环助推器发动机，用于为“爱马仕”计划（CTV-G-5）中美国制造的“瀑布”导弹提供动力。尽管该设计被认为不适合军用，但仍试射了数枚“爱马仕”A-1导弹，以获取大型火箭建造与操作方面的经验。

src: A small solid kick motor. Developed from the Altair, this final version was used on later Scout B launch vehicles. It was used to circularize at apogee or perform a final payload kick. Maximum thrust 25.6 kN, burn time 31 seconds.
zh: 小型固体变轨发动机。由 Altair 发动机发展而来，该最终版本用于后期的侦察兵 B 运载火箭。常用于远地点圆化轨道或完成最后的有效载荷变轨。最大推力 25.6 kN，工作时间 31 秒。

src: A small French solid rocket motor that was developed as a fourth stage for the Europa II launch vehicle, and later used as the third stage on the B and BP.4 configurations of the Diamant launch vehicle.
zh: 法国研制的小型固体火箭发动机，最初作为欧罗巴 II 运载火箭的第四级研发，后来用于钻石号运载火箭 B 和 BP.4 构型的第三级。

src: The Allison/General Electric J35 is an axial flow turbojet, and one of the first turbojets natively designed in the United States. Although not as well known as its later derivative, the J47, it still powered many late 40s aircraft such as the FJ-1, F-84, F-89, XP-86, XB-45, XB-47, X-5, and D-558.
zh: 艾里逊/通用电气 J35 是一款轴流式涡轮喷气发动机，也是美国本土最早自主设计的涡喷发动机之一。尽管其知名度不如后来的衍生型号 J47，但它仍为 40 年代末的许多飞机提供了动力，例如 FJ-1、F-84、F-89、XP-86、XB-45、XB-47、X-5 和 D-558。

src: The latest in research and development enabled the development of this little marvel, The Sensor Array Computing Nose Cone. It is outfitted with many "quality" sensors and a computer salvaged from the highest quality aircraft scrap, enabling it to collect atmospheric data while in flight.
zh: 研发部门的最新成果孕育了这一微型奇迹：传感器阵列计算鼻锥头。它配备了许多“优质”传感器，以及从最高品质飞行器废料中抢救出来的计算机，使其能够在飞行过程中收集大气数据。

drift.src: The latest in research and development enabled the development of this little marvel, The Sensor Array Computing Nose Co
drift.zh: 研发部门的最新成果孕育了这一微型奇迹：传感器阵列计算鼻锥头。它配备了许多“优质”传感器，以及从最高品质飞行器废料中抢救出来的计算机，使其能够在飞行过程中收集大气数据。

src: Specialized animated swing arm for the Delta IV rocket. This is the lowest arm, which provides umbilicals for the core tanks. The arm's length and spread of the outer umbilical rails can be adjusted with the deploy limit sliders. The length of the umbilicals can also be separately adjusted, and the truss block spacers can be turned off as well, or the whole umbilical assembly can be turned off completely. The arm has 8 color options, and the two sets of arm pipes can be separately switched among 4 colors. Arm retraction is in only one direction.
zh: 德尔塔 IV 火箭专用的动画摆臂。这是最低的一根摆臂，为核心级贮箱提供脐带缆连接。摆臂长度和外部脐带滑轨展开度可通过开启限制滑块调节。脐带缆长度也可单独调节，桁架垫块可以关闭，或者彻底关闭整个脐带组件。摆臂有 8 种颜色可选，两组摆臂管路可在 4 种颜色间独立切换。摆臂仅向单一方向回缩。

src: A multi-height additional section for the Large General Modular Service Tower, available in 8 colors. Optional side panels in multiple configurations are also available. Use with the General Umbilicals and Swing Arms.
zh: 大型通用模块化勤务塔的多高度附加节，有 8 种颜色可选。还提供多种构型的可选侧面板。可配合通用脐带缆和摆臂使用。

src: Medium-size animated general swing arm for the general and specialty towers, available in 8 colors. The arm swing can be done in the default or alternate direction by using the appropriate toggle; arm swing done by staging is only in the default direction. The umbilical connectors can be switched between conventional end type and Delta IV side type; side type can be on either side of the arm depending on arm swing direction. The end connecters have 5 style options, and the side connectors can be tall or short, with the center and outer sets separately toggleable. Each of the arm pipes can be switched among 4 colors. The arm can be adjusted in length by using the deploy limit slider. The spacing of the outer umbilical rails for the side style can be decreased using its deploy limit slider.
zh: 用于通用和专用发射塔的中型动画通用摆臂，有 8 种颜色可选。可通过对应的开关使摆臂朝默认或反向摆动；通过分级触发的摆臂摆动仅向默认方向进行。脐带连接器可在常规端接式与德尔塔 IV 侧接式之间切换；侧接式可根据摆臂摆动方向置于摆臂任意一侧。端部连接器有 5 种样式可选，侧部连接器可选高或矮，且中心与外侧组可分别开关。每根摆臂管路可在 4 种颜色间切换。摆臂长度可通过开启限制滑块调节。侧接样式的外部脐带滑轨间距可通过其开启限制滑块缩小。

src: The 3m short section for the modular version of the Titan II GLV Service Tower with optional details. Attach the tower core sections to the top of the base. The section has 3 optional platforms that can be moved down up to 6m using the deploy limit sliders, or be turned off. A structural detail pole also can be turned on and moved up 6m with its deploy limit slider. Umbilical attach nodes can be toggled between the Titan II Tower and General types.
zh: 大力神 II GLV 勤务塔模块化版本的 3m 短节，带可选细节。将塔架核心节连接到底座顶部。该短节带有 3 个可选平台，可使用开启限制滑块向下移动最多 6m，或直接关闭。还可以开启一根结构细节立柱，并用其开启限制滑块向上移动 6m。脐带连接节点可在“大力神 II 塔架”与“通用”类型之间开关切换。

src: This is the base for the Shuttle Launch Platform, and can be also used with an accurate SLS recreation. The base attaches to the shuttle's External Tank via the large node in the center, and requires a free attach node below the center of the shuttle's External Tank in order to be attached. The base attaches to the SLS via the large attach node on the deck in the area of the SSME exhaust hole. The Fixed Service Structure Tower (FSS) base attaches to the large node off to the side of the launch base. The SLS tower base attaches to the 3rd large node opposite the SSME hole. There are 3 deck variants for different kinds of shuttle stacks and a 4th variant for the SLS. SRB hold-downs are integrated into the base and are adjusted with the deploy limit sliders. The shuttle tail service masts attach on the sides of the square main engine exhaust hole, either with the two nodes or by surface attach. The whole base can be rotated via the switcher to keep the support legs in the right place.
zh: 航天飞机发射平台的基座，也可用于精确还原 SLS。基座通过中心的巨大节点连接到航天飞机外贮箱，并要求航天飞机外贮箱中心下方有一个空余的连接节点以供挂载。基座通过甲板上 SSME 喷流孔区域的大型连接节点连接到 SLS。固定勤务结构塔（FSS）基座连接到发射基座外侧的大节点。SLS 塔架基座连接到 SSME 孔对面的第 3 个大节点。共有 3 种用于不同航天飞机组合体的甲板变体，以及用于 SLS 的第 4 种变体。固体助推器压紧装置集成于基座中，可通过开启限制滑块进行调节。航天飞机尾部勤务桅杆通过两个节点或表面附着方式安装在方形主发动机喷流孔的两侧。整个基座可通过切换器旋转，以确保支撑腿处于正确位置。

src: Balloon tanks do not have an internal framework, but instead rely on internal pressurization to keep its shape. If the pressurization fails, the balloon tank collapses. They are constructed of very thin sheets of stainless steel and have very good mass fractions, but the logistics involved in maintaining pressurization make them quite expensive. These early balloon tanks were first used by Atlas and the Centaur C upper stage.
zh: 气球贮箱没有内部框架，而是依靠内部增压来维持形状。如果失去增压，气球贮箱就会坍缩。它们由极薄的不锈钢板制成，具有非常优秀的质量比，但维持增压所需的后勤保障使其造价相当昂贵。这些早期的气球贮箱最初用于宇宙神以及半人马座 C 上面级。

src: A small solid kick motor. Developed from the Altair, this successor was used on Scout and Delta. Used to circularize at apogee or perform final payload kick. Average thrust 28.48 kN, burn time 22 seconds. Diameter: [0.45 m].
zh: 小型固体变轨发动机。由 Altair 发展而来，此后继型号曾用于侦察兵和德尔塔火箭。用于在远地点圆化轨道或完成最后的有效载荷变轨。平均推力 28.48 kN，工作时间 22 秒。直径：[0.45 m]。

src: The Hollow Interstage allows you to change the Diameter of the part to fit many different configurations for your craft. It allows for customization of Decoupling just the bottom node as normal, or both nodes like a separator.
zh: 空心中级段允许你修改部件直径，以适配飞行器的多种不同构型。它支持自定义分离方式：既可按常规仅分离底部节点，也可像分离器一样同时分离两个节点。

src: The Advanced Visible Imaging Device is used to take images in the visibile wavelength of planetary bodies from space. This camera is fully digital, which makes it able to function in low-light conditions and reduces mass and power draw. Historically, this type of camera was flown on Galileo and took images of Jupiter and it's moons.
zh: 先进可见光成像设备用于从太空中拍摄行星天体的可见光波段图像。该相机为全数码设计，使其能在弱光条件下工作，并降低了质量与功耗。在历史上，这类相机曾搭载于伽利略号探测器上，拍摄了木星及其卫星的图像。

src: A expander bleed cycle engine developed in the 2000s. It was a Mitsubishi and Boeing joint project for Delta IV cryogenic upper stages.
zh: 2000年代研制的膨胀排放循环发动机。为三菱与波音联合研发的项目，用于德尔塔IV的低温上面级。

src: A staged combustion upper stage vernier engine developed for the R-36M second stage. This represents 1/4th of an RD-0230. The R-36M2 used an upgraded version of the engine known as the RD-0257.
zh: 为R-36M二级研制的分级燃烧上面级游标发动机。相当于一台RD-0230的1/4。R-36M2使用了该发动机的升级版本，即RD-0257。

src: A British kerolox booster engine for the Blue Streak missile and the first stage of the Europa launch vehicle. It was derived from the Rocketdyne S-3, with minor modifications.
zh: 英国用于“蓝光”导弹及“欧罗巴”运载火箭第一级的液氧煤油助推器发动机。由洛克达因S-3衍生而来，仅作了少量改动。

src: The Star 13 was developed in the mid-1960s as the braking motor for the AIMP program, and was used on Explorer 33 and 35.
